parameters.query: SELECT c.id, c.email, c.lead_score, c.lead_status, c.company, c.created_at, COUNT(la.id) as activity_count, MAX(la.created_at) as last_activity FROM contacts c LEFT JOIN lead_activities la ON c.id = la.contact_id WHERE c.lead_status NOT IN ('customer', 'lost') AND c.updated_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.lead_score DESC
UPDATE contacts SET lead_score = {{ $json.new_score }}, lead_status = '{{ $json.new_status }}' WHERE id = {{ $json.id }}

INSERT INTO lead_activities (contact_id, activity_type, activity_data, score_impact) VALUES ({{ $json.id }}, 'score_update', '{"old_score": {{ $json.lead_score }}, "new_score": {{ $json.new_score }}, "reason": "automated_recalculation"}', {{ $json.new_score - $json.lead_score }})
